paramShapeTT: This parameter will set the board shape.
paramShapeCustomTT: This parameter will set the board shape, choosing the CUSTOM option will allow you to drow your own shape.
dimensionTT: The number of sites par side.
Brick: Generates a board with a brick tiling.
Celtic: Generates a board based on a celtic knotwork.
Concentric: Generates a board based on a tiling of concentric shapes.
Hex: Generates a board with an hexagonal tiling.
Quadhex: Generates a board based on an hexagon tessellated by quadrilaterals.
Spiral: Generates a board based on a spiral tiling. (For games on vertexes or edges.)
Square: Generates a board with a square tiling.
Triangle: Generates a board with a triangular tiling.
Tiling: Generates a board based on a known tiling.
Wedge: Generates a triangular board, with one vertex at the top and a certain number at the bottom. (For games on vertexes or edges.)
diagTypeTT: How to handle diagonals between opposite corners.
gamenameTT: Sets the name of the game.
modeTT:
Sets the mode of the game.
Alternating: turn by turn.
Simultaneous: players move at the same time.
Simulation: simulation game.
playersTT: Sets the number of player of the game.
Cell: Game will be played on cells.
Edge: Game will be played on edges.
Vertex: Game will be played on vertexes.
polyExplain:
Polygons are made in the "Polygon" tab
You can navigate the grid by pressing the middle button (the wheel) of the mouse.
Left click on a dot to add it to the polygon.
Right click on a dot to remove it from the polygon.
2dimTT: Secondary dimension of the board. Only used if the selected shape is "Prism"
